name: Sheds/storage cabins
description:
Wooden sheds and storage cabins

49 wooden sheds and storage cabins from €1,349 to €5,689, with 2 to 18 m² inside. For tools, bikes, a mower or firewood. 47 models have 28 mm solid walls and two have 44 mm. Each comes as a flat-pack kit with a timber floor, delivered to the UK, Ireland and Europe.

What to look for in a garden shed

You want to storeLook for
Hand tools, small items2–5 m² inside, a single door
Bikes and a mower7–10 m² and a double door
A workbench or a hobby corner10 m² and up, a window, or a 44 mm model

Door. Measure your widest item first. Door width and type are listed on each product page; many larger sheds have a double door.

Windows. Most sheds have single glazing, which is enough for storage. A few have double glazing.

Terrace. Seven models add a small covered terrace, useful for firewood or a bench.

Base. A shed needs a flat, firm base: paving slabs, a gravel bed with a timber frame, or ground screws. Treat the timber after assembly.

Need more room? See garden cabins or garages and carports.

Shed questions

Can I build a shed myself? Yes. Two people with basic tools can put up a small shed. See how assembly works.

Is 28 mm enough? For storage, yes. For a workshop you will heat, choose a thicker wall.
